Professional Summary

- Collaborated via Confluence and Jira to document API contracts and track sprint work, delivering multiple production REST APIs for transaction status and settlement.

- Modeled and optimized MySQL schemas for policy and claim data, reduced average query latency by 45% and improved report generation times.
- Packaged services with Docker for consistent CI/CD pipelines; introduced service-level contract tests for REST APIs to prevent regressions during releases.
- Maintained technical documentation in Confluence and managed sprint tasks and bug tracking in Jira while collaborating across product and QA teams.
